q: 经理说会议定在___。
zh: 经理说会议定在十月五号下午三点。
py: jīng lǐ shuō huì yì dìng zài shí yuè wǔ hào xià wǔ sān diǎn
en: The manager said the meeting is set for 3 p.m. on October 5th.
why: Chinese runs big to small: month, day, part of day, hour. The English-style small-to-large orders are not used in Chinese.

q: 我___去医院看牙。
zh: 我星期五上午去医院看牙。
py: wǒ xīng qī wǔ shàng wǔ qù yī yuàn kàn yá
en: I'm going to the hospital to see the dentist on Friday morning.
why: The day comes before the part of day: 星期五上午. 上午星期五 puts the smaller unit first, and slipping 在 in between does not repair the order.

q: 这家公司是___成立的。
zh: 这家公司是一九九八年六月成立的。
py: zhè jiā gōng sī shì yī jiǔ jiǔ bā nián liù yuè chéng lì de
en: The company was founded in June 1998.
why: The year comes first and the month after it. 六月一九九八年 copies the English order of month before year.

q: 今天是___，别忘了交报告。
zh: 今天是三月二号星期四，别忘了交报告。
py: jīn tiān shì sān yuè èr hào xīng qī sì bié wàng le jiāo bào gào
en: Today is Thursday, March 2nd, so don't forget to hand in the report.
why: Month, day, then weekday: 三月二号星期四. The date goes from the bigger unit to the smaller one, never day before month.

q: 体检的时间是___，请空腹来。
zh: 体检的时间是下周二上午八点，请空腹来。
py: tǐ jiǎn de shí jiān shì xià zhōu èr shàng wǔ bā diǎn qǐng kōng fù lái
en: The check-up is at 8 a.m. next Tuesday; please come on an empty stomach.
why: The week and weekday come first, then the part of day, then the hour: 下周二上午八点. Putting 上午八点 first reverses the large-to-small order.

q: 部门聚餐定在___，地点还没有确定。
opts: 下个月十八号星期六晚上七点
下个月晚上七点十八号星期六
晚上七点星期六十八号下个月
zh: 部门聚餐定在下个月十八号星期六晚上七点，地点还没有确定。
py: bù mén jù cān dìng zài xià gè yuè shí bā hào xīng qī liù wǎn shàng qī diǎn dì diǎn hái méi yǒu què dìng
en: The department dinner is set for 7 p.m. on Saturday the 18th of next month, but the venue isn't settled.
why: The whole expression runs month, date, weekday, part of day, hour. Any option that starts with the hour or part of day reverses the big-to-small order.

q: 医生让我___来复查，还要带上上次的报告。
zh: 医生让我下个月八号上午十点来复查，还要带上上次的报告。
py: yī shēng ràng wǒ xià gè yuè bā hào shàng wǔ shí diǎn lái fù chá hái yào dài shàng shàng cì de bào gào
en: The doctor told me to come back for a follow-up at 10 a.m. on the 8th of next month and to bring the last report.
why: Month, date, part of day, hour: 下个月八号上午十点. English-style small-to-large orders sound wrong in Chinese.

zh: 会议在星期五下午两点开始。
py: huì yì zài xīng qī wǔ xià wǔ liǎng diǎn kāi shǐ
en: The meeting starts at 2 p.m. on Friday.
why: The weekday comes before the time of day, and the whole phrase follows 在 and sits before 开始. 下午两点星期五 would reverse the order.

zh: 经理十二月二十号上午出差。
py: jīng lǐ shí èr yuè èr shí hào shàng wǔ chū chāi
en: The manager is going on a business trip on the morning of December 20th.
why: The time expression is in large-to-small order and sits before the verb, either after the subject or before it. It cannot be left after 出差.

s: 我去医院做体检下周二上午九点。
s_py: wǒ qù yī yuàn zuò tǐ jiǎn xià zhōu èr shàng wǔ jiǔ diǎn
zh: 我下周二上午九点去医院做体检。
py: wǒ xià zhōu èr shàng wǔ jiǔ diǎn qù yī yuàn zuò tǐ jiǎn
en: I'm going to the hospital for a check-up at 9 a.m. next Tuesday.
why: The time expression must stand before the verb phrase. Left at the end it sounds like English word order and is not Chinese.

s: 星期五下午四点半我要去牙科复诊。
s_py: xīng qī wǔ xià wǔ sì diǎn bàn wǒ yào qù yá kē fù zhěn
zh: 星期五下午四点半我要去牙科复诊。
py: xīng qī wǔ xià wǔ sì diǎn bàn wǒ yào qù yá kē fù zhěn
en: I have a dental follow-up at 4:30 on Friday afternoon.
why: Weekday, part of day, then clock time is the correct big-to-small order, and a time phrase may open the sentence before the subject.

q: 我们___下班。
zh: 我们五点半下班。
py: wǒ men wǔ diǎn bàn xià bān
en: We finish work at half past five.
why: 半 comes right after 点: 五点半. 五半点 reverses them, and 三十 and 半 are two ways of saying the same thing so they cannot be combined.

q: 现在是___，该吃药了。
zh: 现在是两点，该吃药了。
py: xiàn zài shì liǎng diǎn gāi chī yào le
en: It's two o'clock now; time to take the medicine.
why: Two o'clock is 两点. 两 is used when counting hours, while 二 is kept for digits, ordinals and the tens.

q: 现在___八点，我们得走了。
zh: 现在差五分八点，我们得走了。
py: xiàn zài chà wǔ fēn bā diǎn wǒ men děi zǒu le
en: It's five to eight; we have to go.
why: 差 comes first: 差五分八点, meaning 'five minutes short of eight'. 五分差 puts the shortfall word after the number.

q: 会议___结束，我们可以去吃饭了。
zh: 会议十二点一刻结束，我们可以去吃饭了。
py: huì yì shí èr diǎn yī kè jié shù wǒ men kě yǐ qù chī fàn le
en: The meeting ends at a quarter past twelve, and then we can go for lunch.
why: A quarter is one 刻, so quarter past twelve is 十二点一刻. 刻 is not combined with 十五, and the number goes before 刻.

q: 体检中心下午___关门，你得早点去。
zh: 体检中心下午四点三刻关门，你得早点去。
py: tǐ jiǎn zhōng xīn xià wǔ sì diǎn sān kè guān mén nǐ děi zǎo diǎn qù
en: The check-up centre closes at a quarter to five p.m., so you have to go early.
why: Four fifteen-minute units make a whole hour, so 45 minutes is 三刻: 四点三刻. 四刻 does not exist as a clock time.

q: 我每天早上七___起床，然后去跑步。
zh: 我每天早上七点起床，然后去跑步。
py: wǒ měi tiān zǎo shàng qī diǎn qǐ chuáng rán hòu qù pǎo bù
en: I get up at seven every morning and then go for a run.
why: A clock time uses 点. 小时 measures a stretch of time, so 七小时起床 would mean seven hours of getting up.

q: 会议从九点开到十一点，一共开了两___。
zh: 会议从九点开到十一点，一共开了两个小时。
py: huì yì cóng jiǔ diǎn kāi dào shí yī diǎn yī gòng kāi le liǎng gè xiǎo shí
en: The meeting ran from nine to eleven, two hours in total.
why: A length of time takes 小时 with its measure 个. 两点 would be the clock time two o'clock, which does not fit 开了.

q: 我___有个视频会议，不能去吃饭了。
zh: 我两点半有个视频会议，不能去吃饭了。
py: wǒ liǎng diǎn bàn yǒu gè shì pín huì yì bù néng qù chī fàn le
en: I have a video conference at half past two, so I can't go for lunch.
why: Two o'clock is 两点, and 半 follows 点: 两点半. 二点半 uses the wrong two, and 半两点 reverses the order.

q: 现在差十分___，李经理还没到办公室，会议可能要推迟。
zh: 现在差十分十一点，李经理还没到办公室，会议可能要推迟。
py: xiàn zài chà shí fēn shí yī diǎn lǐ jīng lǐ hái méi dào bàn gōng shì huì yì kě néng yào tuī chí
en: It's ten to eleven and Manager Li isn't in yet, so the meeting may be delayed.
why: After 差 and the minutes comes the hour being approached: 差十分十一点. 十一分 would be minutes and 小时 is a duration, neither names a clock hour.

zh: 会议九点一刻才开始。
py: huì yì jiǔ diǎn yī kè cái kāi shǐ
en: The meeting doesn't start until a quarter past nine.
why: The clock time and 才 both come before the verb, with 才 right in front of 开始. The time phrase may open the sentence or follow 会议, but never come after 开始.

zh: 现在差五分九点。
py: xiàn zài chà wǔ fēn jiǔ diǎn
en: It's five to nine now.
why: 差 plus the minutes comes before the hour: 差五分九点. The hour cannot come before 差.

s: 我们二点半有个会。
s_py: wǒ men èr diǎn bàn yǒu gè huì
zh: 我们两点半有个会。
py: wǒ men liǎng diǎn bàn yǒu gè huì
en: We have a meeting at half past two.
why: Two o'clock is 两点, not 二点. 二 is only for digit strings, ordinals and the tens.

s: 他每天早上八小时上班，晚上六点下班。
s_py: tā měi tiān zǎo shàng bā xiǎo shí shàng bān wǎn shàng liù diǎn xià bān
zh: 他每天早上八点上班，晚上六点下班。
py: tā měi tiān zǎo shàng bā diǎn shàng bān wǎn shàng liù diǎn xià bān
en: He starts work at eight every morning and finishes at six in the evening.
why: A clock time is 点, not 小时. 八小时 means eight hours of duration, which cannot say when work starts.

s: 手术九点零五分开始，大概要两个小时。
s_py: shǒu shù jiǔ diǎn líng wǔ fēn kāi shǐ dà gài yào liǎng gè xiǎo shí
zh: 手术九点零五分开始，大概要两个小时。
py: shǒu shù jiǔ diǎn líng wǔ fēn kāi shǐ dà gài yào liǎng gè xiǎo shí
en: The operation starts at 9:05 and should take about two hours.
why: A single-digit minute after 点 takes 零, so 九点零五分 is right. 两个小时 is a duration, which correctly uses 小时.

q: 这个月公司一共卖了___台电脑。
zh: 这个月公司一共卖了一百零五台电脑。
py: zhè gè yuè gōng sī yī gòng mài le yī bǎi líng wǔ tái diàn nǎo
en: This month the company sold 105 computers in total.
why: A skipped tens place needs 零: 105 is 一百零五. 一百五 and 一百五十 both mean 150.

q: 这次体检的费用是___块。
zh: 这次体检的费用是两千零八块。
py: zhè cì tǐ jiǎn de fèi yòng shì liǎng qiān líng bā kuài
en: The check-up costs 2,008 yuan.
why: The empty hundreds place takes one 零: 两千零八. 两千八 would be 2,800, and 零十八 is wrong because 零 already covers the gap.

q: 我们部门一共有___个人。
zh: 我们部门一共有一百一十个人。
py: wǒ men bù mén yī gòng yǒu yī bǎi yī shí gè rén
en: Our department has 110 people.
why: Inside a number above 100, ten is said 一十: 一百一十. 一百十 drops the 一 that 十 needs in the middle of a number.

q: 这份文件有___页，我今天看不完。
zh: 这份文件有二十页，我今天看不完。
py: zhè fèn wén jiàn yǒu èr shí yè wǒ jīn tiān kàn bù wán
en: This document has twenty pages and I can't finish reading it today.
why: Twenty is 二十, with 二 in the tens. 两 is only for counting a measured group, and 二百 would be two hundred.

q: 公司今年的利润是___元，比去年多了不少。
zh: 公司今年的利润是一百万元，比去年多了不少。
py: gōng sī jīn nián de lì rùn shì yī bǎi wàn yuán bǐ qù nián duō le bù shǎo
en: The company's profit this year is one million yuan, a good deal more than last year.
why: One million is 一百万, a hundred ten-thousands. 十万 is 100,000 and 一千万 is ten million.

q: 这个城市有___人，上班的路上总是堵车。
zh: 这个城市有两千万人，上班的路上总是堵车。
py: zhè gè chéng shì yǒu liǎng qiān wàn rén shàng bān de lù shàng zǒng shì dǔ chē
en: This city has twenty million people, and there is always traffic on the way to work.
why: Twenty million is two thousand 万: 两千万. 两百万 is two million and 两亿 is two hundred million.

zh: 这台机器要一万零五百块。
py: zhè tái jī qì yào yī wàn líng wǔ bǎi kuài
en: This machine costs 10,500 yuan.
why: The empty thousands place between 一万 and 五百 takes one 零: 一万零五百. Without 零 it would read as 15,000 or be ungrammatical.

s: 这家医院每年有十千个病人来看病。
s_py: zhè jiā yī yuàn měi nián yǒu shí qiān gè bìng rén lái kàn bìng
zh: 这家医院每年有一万个病人来看病。
py: zhè jiā yī yuàn měi nián yǒu yī wàn gè bìng rén lái kàn bìng
en: This hospital sees ten thousand patients a year.
why: Chinese counts in units of 万, so 10,000 is 一万. 十千 is never said.

s: 我们的年会预算是一百零五万元。
s_py: wǒ men de nián huì yù suàn shì yī bǎi líng wǔ wàn yuán
zh: 我们的年会预算是一百零五万元。
py: wǒ men de nián huì yù suàn shì yī bǎi líng wǔ wàn yuán
en: Our annual party budget is 1,050,000 yuan.
why: 一百零五 is 105 and 万 multiplies it, giving 1,050,000. The 零 inside 一百零五 is correct, so the sentence is fine.

q: 这支笔___，不贵。
zh: 这支笔两块，不贵。
py: zhè zhī bǐ liǎng kuài bù guì
en: This pen is two yuan, so it isn't expensive.
why: Two units of money take 两: 两块. 二 is kept for digits and ordinals.

q: 这瓶药水一共十三___八毛。
zh: 这瓶药水一共十三块八毛。
py: zhè píng yào shuǐ yī gòng shí sān kuài bā máo
en: This bottle of medicated lotion costs 13.80 yuan in total.
why: Spoken prices go 块 then 毛 then 分, so the yuan unit 块 sits before 八毛. 毛 twice would make no sense.

q: 这盒创可贴三块五，两盒一共___。
zh: 这盒创可贴三块五，两盒一共七块。
py: zhè hé chuàng kě tiē sān kuài wǔ liǎng hé yī gòng qī kuài
en: A box of plasters is 3.50 yuan, so two boxes come to seven yuan.
why: Money amounts take 块 as the unit: 七块. 个 does not count money and 七毛 would be only 0.70 yuan.

q: 药费一共两百___，医保已经报销了一半。
zh: 药费一共两百块，医保已经报销了一半。
py: yào fèi yī gòng liǎng bǎi kuài yī bǎo yǐ jīng bào xiāo le yī bàn
en: The medicine cost 200 yuan in total, and insurance already covered half.
why: Hundreds of yuan are counted with 块: 两百块. 毛 and 分 are the small units under a yuan.

q: 打印店一张彩色的要一块___，黑白的才五毛。
zh: 打印店一张彩色的要一块五，黑白的才五毛。
py: dǎ yìn diàn yī zhāng cǎi sè de yào yī kuài wǔ hēi bái de cái wǔ máo
en: At the print shop a colour page is one yuan fifty, and black and white is only fifty cents.
why: In 一块五 the last unit is dropped and means five 毛. 零五 would be 1.05 and 五块 would be five more yuan.

q: 一共三块五，我给了他五块，他找了我___。
zh: 一共三块五，我给了他五块，他找了我一块五。
py: yī gòng sān kuài wǔ wǒ gěi le tā wǔ kuài tā zhǎo le wǒ yī kuài wǔ
en: It came to 3.50 and I gave him five yuan, so he gave me one yuan fifty in change.
why: The amount is 一块五: yuan first, then the 毛 digit with the last unit dropped. 块 cannot go before the number.

zh: 这瓶药一共三块八毛。
py: zhè píng yào yī gòng sān kuài bā máo
en: This bottle of medicine is 3.80 yuan in total.
why: In spoken prices 块 comes before 毛, so 三块八毛 is the order. Reversing them would not make sense.

zh: 这支体温计要二十八块五。
py: zhè zhī tǐ wēn jì yào èr shí bā kuài wǔ
en: This thermometer costs 28.50 yuan.
why: The final unit is dropped: 二十八块五 means 28.50. The digit 五 comes after 块, never before it.

s: 这杯咖啡三毛五块，不算贵。
s_py: zhè bēi kā fēi sān máo wǔ kuài bù suàn guì
zh: 这杯咖啡三块五，不算贵。
py: zhè bēi kā fēi sān kuài wǔ bù suàn guì
en: This coffee is 3.50 yuan, which isn't expensive.
why: Spoken prices go from yuan to smaller units: 三块五. 三毛五块 reverses 块 and 毛.

s: 这盒药是四十五块，不用找零。
s_py: zhè hé yào shì sì shí wǔ kuài bù yòng zhǎo líng
zh: 这盒药是四十五块，不用找零。
py: zhè hé yào shì sì shí wǔ kuài bù yòng zhǎo líng
en: This box of medicine is 45 yuan; no change is needed.
why: A price can be stated with 是 plus the amount, and 块 is the normal spoken unit. The sentence is fine as it is.

q: 办公室里有二十___同事，大家都很忙。
zh: 办公室里有二十多个同事，大家都很忙。
py: bàn gōng shì lǐ yǒu èr shí duō gè tóng shì dà jiā dōu hěn máng
en: There are twenty-odd colleagues in the office, and everyone is busy.
why: After a round number, 多 comes before the measure: 二十多个. 个多 would put the extra part after the measure, which is only for one to nine.

q: 我已经三___月没去医院了。
zh: 我已经三个多月没去医院了。
py: wǒ yǐ jīng sān gè duō yuè méi qù yī yuàn le
en: I haven't been to the hospital for over three months.
why: With 1 to 9 the measure comes first and 多 after it: 三个多月. 三多个月 reverses them.

q: 他每天睡___，睡得太少了。
zh: 他每天睡七个小时左右，睡得太少了。
py: tā měi tiān shuì qī gè xiǎo shí zuǒ yòu shuì de tài shǎo le
en: He sleeps about seven hours a day, which is too little.
why: 左右 goes after the whole number phrase: 七个小时左右. It cannot be put in front of the number or inside it.

q: 参加会议的只有___人，大部分人都请假了。
zh: 参加会议的只有十几个人，大部分人都请假了。
py: cān jiā huì yì de zhǐ yǒu shí jǐ gè rén dà bù fēn rén dōu qǐng jiǎ le
en: Only ten-odd people attended the meeting; most had asked for leave.
why: 十几 is 11 to 19. 几十 means twenty to ninety, which cannot fit 'only'.

q: 医生，请问我一天吃___次药？
zh: 医生，请问我一天吃几次药？
py: yī shēng qǐng wèn wǒ yī tiān chī jǐ cì yào
en: Doctor, how many times a day should I take the medicine?
why: 几 asks about a small number before a measure: 几次. 多 and 大概 cannot stand directly before 次 as a question word.

q: 我们科一共有___医生，护士比医生还多。
zh: 我们科一共有三十多个医生，护士比医生还多。
py: wǒ men kē yī gòng yǒu sān shí duō gè yī shēng hù shì bǐ yī shēng hái duō
en: Our department has thirty-odd doctors, and even more nurses.
why: With a round number like 三十, 多 follows the number and comes before the measure: 三十多个.

q: 我们等了___，经理才到办公室。
zh: 我们等了一个多小时，经理才到办公室。
py: wǒ men děng le yī gè duō xiǎo shí jīng lǐ cái dào bàn gōng shì
en: We waited more than an hour before the manager reached the office.
why: For 1 to 9, the measure comes before 多: 一个多小时. 一多个 reverses them.

q: 药费一共花了一百___块。
zh: 药费一共花了一百多块。
py: yào fèi yī gòng huā le yī bǎi duō kuài
en: The medicine cost a little over a hundred yuan altogether.
why: After a round number 多 comes before the measure: 一百多块. 个 is not the measure here and cannot follow a hundred.

q: 新来的同事看起来___，人很好。
zh: 新来的同事看起来三十岁左右，人很好。
py: xīn lái de tóng shì kàn qǐ lái sān shí suì zuǒ yòu rén hěn hǎo
en: The new colleague looks about thirty and is a nice person.
why: 左右 comes after the full number phrase, so 三十岁左右. It does not go before the number or in the middle of it.

q: 他为了赶项目，连续加班了___，终于累得生病了。
zh: 他为了赶项目，连续加班了十几天，终于累得生病了。
py: tā wèi le gǎn xiàng mù lián xù jiā bān le shí jǐ tiān zhōng yú lèi de shēng bìng le
en: To meet the project deadline he worked overtime for ten-odd days in a row and finally fell ill.
why: 十几 means 11 to 19: 十几天. 几十天 means twenty to ninety days, which does not match.

q: 这个小区有___户人家，一家诊所肯定不够用。
zh: 这个小区有几千户人家，一家诊所肯定不够用。
py: zhè gè xiǎo qū yǒu jǐ qiān hù rén jiā yī jiā zhěn suǒ kěn dìng bù gòu yòng
en: This neighbourhood has several thousand households, so one clinic is certainly not enough.
why: 几 stands before the unit for an unknown small number: 几千 is several thousand. 千几 reverses them.

zh: 他大概三十岁左右。
py: tā dà gài sān shí suì zuǒ yòu
en: He's roughly thirty.
why: 左右 follows the age and 大概 stands before it. 左右 cannot be placed ahead of 三十岁.

zh: 我们科有二十多个护士。
py: wǒ men kē yǒu èr shí duō gè hù shì
en: Our department has twenty-odd nurses.
why: With a round number, 多 comes after the number and before the measure: 二十多个. 二十个多 would be wrong.

zh: 我等了三个多小时。
py: wǒ děng le sān gè duō xiǎo shí
en: I waited for over three hours.
why: With 1 to 9, the measure comes before 多: 三个多小时. 三多个小时 is wrong.

s: 我已经等了二十个多分钟了。
s_py: wǒ yǐ jīng děng le èr shí gè duō fēn zhōng le
zh: 我已经等了二十多分钟了。
py: wǒ yǐ jīng děng le èr shí duō fēn zhōng le
en: I've already waited more than twenty minutes.
why: After a round number such as 二十, 多 is attached directly to the number and the measure follows. 二十个多分钟 puts 个 in the wrong place.

s: 我们公司有一百多个员工，还不到两百个。
s_py: wǒ men gōng sī yǒu yī bǎi duō gè yuán gōng hái bù dào liǎng bǎi gè
zh: 我们公司有一百多个员工，还不到两百个。
py: wǒ men gōng sī yǒu yī bǎi duō gè yuán gōng hái bù dào liǎng bǎi gè
en: Our company has a hundred-odd employees, still under two hundred.
why: 一百 is a round number, so 多 goes before the measure: 一百多个. That is the correct slot.

q: 我们公司在___，电梯在左边。
zh: 我们公司在三楼，电梯在左边。
py: wǒ men gōng sī zài sān lóu diàn tī zài zuǒ biān
en: Our company is on the third floor; the lift is on the left.
why: Floors are said with a bare number: 三楼. 第 is not added to a floor number.

q: 我们的会议是在___开的。
zh: 我们的会议是在二月开的。
py: wǒ men de huì yì shì zài èr yuè kāi de
en: Our conference was held in February.
why: Months use a plain number with 月: 二月. 第 is dropped, and 两月 is not used for the second month.

q: 这是我___来这家医院看病，感觉服务很好。
zh: 这是我第二次来这家医院看病，感觉服务很好。
py: zhè shì wǒ dì èr cì lái zhè jiā yī yuàn kàn bìng gǎn jué fú wù hěn hǎo
en: This is the second time I've come to this hospital for treatment, and the service feels great.
why: The second occurrence is 第二次. 两次 would mean 'twice' and cannot follow 这是我 as an ordinal.

q: 我儿子今年上___年级，每天自己走路上学。
zh: 我儿子今年上二年级，每天自己走路上学。
py: wǒ ér zi jīn nián shàng èr nián jí měi tiān zì jǐ zǒu lù shàng xué
en: My son is in second grade this year and walks to school by himself every day.
why: Grades are named with a bare number: 二年级. 第 is dropped, and 两 is only for counting.

q: 我上班___天就迟到了，经理有点生气。
zh: 我上班第一天就迟到了，经理有点生气。
py: wǒ shàng bān dì yī tiān jiù chí dào le jīng lǐ yǒu diǎn shēng qì
en: I was late on my very first day at work, and the manager was a little annoyed.
why: 'The first day' is 第一天. A bare 一天 would mean 'one day' of work, not the first day.

q: 这是公司成立以来的___次员工体检，大家都很重视。
zh: 这是公司成立以来的第五次员工体检，大家都很重视。
py: zhè shì gōng sī chéng lì yǐ lái de dì wǔ cì yuán gōng tǐ jiǎn dà jiā dōu hěn zhòng shì
en: This is the fifth staff check-up since the company was founded, and everyone takes it seriously.
why: The fifth occurrence is 第五次. 五次 would mean 'five times' and would not fit after 的.

zh: 我们办公室在三楼。
py: wǒ men bàn gōng shì zài sān lóu
en: Our office is on the third floor.
why: Floors are said as a plain number plus 楼: 三楼. 第三楼 is not used.

zh: 这是我第三次来这家诊所。
py: zhè shì wǒ dì sān cì lái zhè jiā zhěn suǒ
en: This is the third time I've come to this clinic.
why: The ordinal 第三次 sits before the verb 来, so 第 + number + measure sets the count of occurrences.

s: 今天是第十月三号，银行放假。
s_py: jīn tiān shì dì shí yuè sān hào yín xíng fàng jiǎ
zh: 今天是十月三号，银行放假。
py: jīn tiān shì shí yuè sān hào yín xíng fàng jiǎ
en: Today is October 3rd and the banks are closed.
why: Months are plain numbers plus 月: 十月. 第 is not used with month names.

s: 我们公司二月才开始招人，现在人还不多。
s_py: wǒ men gōng sī èr yuè cái kāi shǐ zhāo rén xiàn zài rén hái bù duō
zh: 我们公司二月才开始招人，现在人还不多。
py: wǒ men gōng sī èr yuè cái kāi shǐ zhāo rén xiàn zài rén hái bù duō
en: Our company only starts hiring in February, so there aren't many people yet.
why: 二月 is simply February, a bare number with 月 and no 第. 两个月 would be 'two months'. The sentence is correct.

q: 我中午睡了___。
zh: 我中午睡了半个小时。
py: wǒ zhōng wǔ shuì le bàn gè xiǎo shí
en: I slept for half an hour at noon.
why: With no whole number, 半 goes before the measure: 半个小时. 个半小时 needs a number in front.

q: 会议开了___，大家都累了。
zh: 会议开了一个半小时，大家都累了。
py: huì yì kāi le yī gè bàn xiǎo shí dà jiā dōu lèi le
en: The meeting ran for an hour and a half and everyone was tired.
why: With a whole number, 半 comes after the measure and before the noun: 一个半小时. 一半个 puts it too early.

q: 病人在医院住了___，明天可以回家了。
zh: 病人在医院住了两天半，明天可以回家了。
py: bìng rén zài yī yuàn zhù le liǎng tiān bàn míng tiān kě yǐ huí jiā le
en: The patient stayed in hospital for two and a half days and can go home tomorrow.
why: When the unit is itself the measure, 半 goes at the very end: 两天半. 两半天 splits the number and the unit.

q: 我在这家公司工作了___，打算换工作了。
zh: 我在这家公司工作了三年半，打算换工作了。
py: wǒ zài zhè jiā gōng sī gōng zuò le sān nián bàn dǎ suàn huàn gōng zuò le
en: I've worked at this company for three and a half years and plan to change jobs.
why: 年 is its own measure, so 半 follows it: 三年半. 三个半年 inserts a measure that 年 does not take.

q: 我弟弟今年___了，已经会说很多话了。
zh: 我弟弟今年一岁半了，已经会说很多话了。
py: wǒ dì dì jīn nián yī suì bàn le yǐ jīng huì shuō hěn duō huà le
en: My little brother is one and a half now and can already say lots of words.
why: 岁 is its own measure, so 半 comes right after it: 一岁半. 个 is not used with 岁.

q: 这种病需要连续吃___的药才能好。
zh: 这种病需要连续吃三个半月的药才能好。
py: zhè zhǒng bìng xū yào lián xù chī sān gè bàn yuè de yào cái néng hǎo
en: This illness needs three and a half months of continuous medication to clear up.
why: A whole number and 个 come first, then 半 before the noun: 三个半月. 三半个月 puts 半 before the measure.

zh: 他等了一个半小时。
py: tā děng le yī gè bàn xiǎo shí
en: He waited an hour and a half.
why: With a whole number, 半 follows the measure 个 and comes before 小时: 一个半小时.

zh: 我午休了半个小时。
py: wǒ wǔ xiū le bàn gè xiǎo shí
en: I took a half-hour lunch break.
why: Without a whole number, 半 goes before the measure: 半个小时, as one tile after 了.

zh: 他上班三年半了。
py: tā shàng bān sān nián bàn le
en: He's been working for three and a half years now.
why: 年 is its own measure, so 半 sits at the very end of the phrase: 三年半.

s: 他已经在这儿工作了两半年。
s_py: tā yǐ jīng zài zhè r gōng zuò le liǎng bàn nián
zh: 他已经在这儿工作了两年半。
py: tā yǐ jīng zài zhè r gōng zuò le liǎng nián bàn
en: He has already worked here for two and a half years.
why: 半 follows 年 when 年 is its own measure: 两年半. 两半年 is not a Chinese pattern.

s: 他在医院住了三个半月，才完全好起来。
s_py: tā zài yī yuàn zhù le sān gè bàn yuè cái wán quán hǎo qǐ lái
zh: 他在医院住了三个半月，才完全好起来。
py: tā zài yī yuàn zhù le sān gè bàn yuè cái wán quán hǎo qǐ lái
en: He stayed in hospital for three and a half months before he fully recovered.
why: 月 takes the measure 个 when counting months, and 半 follows the measure: 三个半月. This is the correct slot.

q: 这家诊所是___年建的。
zh: 这家诊所是一九九八年建的。
py: zhè jiā zhěn suǒ shì yī jiǔ jiǔ bā nián jiàn de
en: This clinic was built in 1998.
why: Years are read digit by digit: 一九九八. Reading it as a quantity, 一千九百九十八, is wrong for a year.

q: 我的办公室是___，在电梯左边。
zh: 我的办公室是二二零八，在电梯左边。
py: wǒ de bàn gōng shì shì èr èr líng bā zài diàn tī zuǒ biān
en: My office is room 2208, on the left of the lift.
why: Room numbers are read digit by digit and the digit two is 二, not 两. 两千二百零八 would read it as a quantity.

q: 他的手机号码以___开头，后面我忘了。
zh: 他的手机号码以幺三八开头，后面我忘了。
py: tā de shǒu jī hào mǎ yǐ yāo sān bā kāi tóu hòu miàn wǒ wàng le
en: His mobile number starts with 138; I've forgotten the rest.
why: Phone numbers are read digit by digit, and 一 is commonly said 幺 (yāo) to avoid confusion. A quantity like 一百三十八 does not fit.

q: 这家药厂是___年成立的，已经有十几年历史了。
zh: 这家药厂是二零一二年成立的，已经有十几年历史了。
py: zhè jiā yào chǎng shì èr líng yī èr nián chéng lì de yǐ jīng yǒu shí jǐ nián lì shǐ le
en: This pharmaceutical plant was founded in 2012 and has over ten years of history.
why: A year is read digit by digit with 二: 二零一二. 两零一二 uses 两 in a digit string, and 两千一十二 reads it as a quantity.

zh: 医院是二零一零年建的。
py: yī yuàn shì èr líng yī líng nián jiàn de
en: The hospital was built in 2010.
why: The year is read digit by digit as one tile, 二零一零年, and sits after 是 and before 建.

zh: 我的房间号是幺零八。
py: wǒ de fáng jiān hào shì yāo líng bā
en: My room number is 108.
why: Room numbers are read digit by digit, and 一 is said 幺: 幺零八.

s: 我的房间号是两零三。
s_py: wǒ de fáng jiān hào shì liǎng líng sān
zh: 我的房间号是二零三。
py: wǒ de fáng jiān hào shì èr líng sān
en: My room number is 203.
why: Digit strings use 二, not 两: 二零三. 两 is only for counting amounts.

s: 我的工号是幺二三四，你记一下。
s_py: wǒ de gōng hào shì yāo èr sān sì nǐ jì yī xià
zh: 我的工号是幺二三四，你记一下。
py: wǒ de gōng hào shì yāo èr sān sì nǐ jì yī xià
en: My employee number is 1234; please note it down.
why: An ID number is read digit by digit, with 一 said 幺 and 二 for two. The sentence is correct.

q: 我爸爸今年六十___，身体还很好。
zh: 我爸爸今年六十岁，身体还很好。
py: wǒ bà bà jīn nián liù shí suì shēn tǐ hái hěn hǎo
en: My dad is sixty this year and still in good health.
why: Age is a number plus 岁 directly: 六十岁. 个 is not used with 岁, and 年 counts years of time.

q: 我女儿___了，已经会自己吃饭了。
zh: 我女儿两岁了，已经会自己吃饭了。
py: wǒ nǚ ér liǎng suì le yǐ jīng huì zì jǐ chī fàn le
en: My daughter is two and can already feed herself.
why: Age two is 两岁, because 两 is used when counting. 二岁 uses the wrong two, and 个 is never inserted before 岁.

q: 公司___的员工都参加了体检。
zh: 公司百分之九十的员工都参加了体检。
py: gōng sī bǎi fēn zhī jiǔ shí de yuán gōng dōu cān jiā le tǐ jiǎn
en: Ninety percent of the company's employees took part in the check-up.
why: Percentages start with 百分之, then the number: 百分之九十. 九十百分 and 百分九十 are not Chinese.

q: 我们部门___是男同事，女同事比较多。
zh: 我们部门三分之一是男同事，女同事比较多。
py: wǒ men bù mén sān fēn zhī yī shì nán tóng shì nǚ tóng shì bǐ jiào duō
en: One third of our department are men; there are more women.
why: A fraction is said denominator first: 三分之一, 'one of three parts'. 一分之三 reverses it.

q: 公司今年的销售量比去年增长了___。
zh: 公司今年的销售量比去年增长了百分之十五。
py: gōng sī jīn nián de xiāo shòu liàng bǐ qù nián zēng zhǎng le bǎi fēn zhī shí wǔ
en: This year's sales volume grew by fifteen percent compared with last year.
why: The pattern is 百分之 + number: 百分之十五. 之 cannot be left out, and the number cannot come before 百分.

zh: 我哥哥今年三十岁。
py: wǒ gē gē jīn nián sān shí suì
en: My older brother is thirty this year.
why: Age follows the subject directly as a number plus 岁, with no 是 and no 个. 今年 may sit before or after the subject.

zh: 百分之八十的员工都来了。
py: bǎi fēn zhī bā shí de yuán gōng dōu lái le
en: Eighty percent of the staff came.
why: 百分之 comes first and then the number: 百分之八十, followed by 的 and the noun.

zh: 他的体重减少了三分之一。
py: tā de tǐ zhòng jiǎn shǎo le sān fēn zhī yī
en: His weight dropped by a third.
why: A fraction names the number of parts first: 三分之一. 一分之三 would reverse numerator and denominator.

s: 百分八十的员工都同意了。
s_py: bǎi fēn bā shí de yuán gōng dōu tóng yì le
zh: 百分之八十的员工都同意了。
py: bǎi fēn zhī bā shí de yuán gōng dōu tóng yì le
en: Eighty percent of the staff agreed.
why: 百分之 is a fixed unit and 之 cannot be dropped: 百分之八十.

s: 我儿子今年十个岁了。
s_py: wǒ ér zi jīn nián shí gè suì le
zh: 我儿子今年十岁了。
py: wǒ ér zi jīn nián shí suì le
en: My son is ten this year.
why: 岁 attaches directly to the number: 十岁. 个 is not used with 岁.

s: 全公司只有四分之一的人喜欢这个计划。
s_py: quán gōng sī zhǐ yǒu sì fēn zhī yī de rén xǐ huān zhè gè jì huà
zh: 全公司只有四分之一的人喜欢这个计划。
py: quán gōng sī zhǐ yǒu sì fēn zhī yī de rén xǐ huān zhè gè jì huà
en: Only a quarter of the whole company likes this plan.
why: 四分之一 has the denominator first and is the correct fraction form for a quarter.
